changelog: `src/lib/guidance/agentFastPath.ts` (484 lines) splits into `copy.ts` (the bilingual sentence table with its key type, still `as const` so the compiler refuses a half-translated rule) and `matching.ts` (the rule chain, node lookups and the `FastPathMatch` result), while `index.ts` keeps the module's doc and the same public API. No caller changed. Previous release: the few-shot corpus and its BM25 retrieval split into `examples.ts`, `bm25.ts` and `index.ts`.
